newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices firm at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices firm at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were firm at the weekly auction in Mombasa, auction officials said.
The auction was held on Tuesday instead of Monday.
BP1s of all categories firmed by up to six U.S. cents while Brighter PF1s gained 4-12 cents. Brighter PDUSTs gained upto 11 cents while Brighter and Medium DUST1s gained 3-8 cents.
Fannings lost value while BMFs were discounted by 15 cents.
Pakistan blenders were active while there was good support from other Middle Eastern countries. Britain was more active.
